basic_info.main_problem: 我仍然爱着我的前Male友,他最近的婚姻让我相信我的爱情前途完全have not了.
basic_info.core_demands: 因前Male友近期结婚而对自己的爱情前景感到强烈despair,希望获得支持与指导.
growth_experiences: 六个月前,前Male友结婚.此后来访者感到心碎与被抛弃,认为自己的爱情前途'完全have not了',并在Being alone或Social situations谈及关系时反复出现without望与Loneliness感.来访者尝试通过Work,爱好与社交来分散注意力,但相关想法持续存在,影响睡眠,自我照料,Work表现和Interpersonal relationships.

core_beliefs: 我not可能在爱情中获得幸福
我的爱情前途完全have not了

special_situations.event: 得知前Male友在六个月前结婚
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If an important intimate partner has already entered marriage, it means I lose the possibility of love
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Uses work, hobbies, and socializing to distract attention

special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们都拥有幸福的关系,只有我not行

special_situations.event: Being alone时想到前Male友已继续他的人生
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果他已经继续前行而我仍停滞not前,意味着我的not yet来注定孤单

defense_goal: Avoids being hurt again through retreat and self-isolation

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When intimate relationships come up in social settings
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believes others are all settled while they are excluded; if they express themselves they will appear to be a failure (transference: self-derogation)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 语气自责,降低音量,避免直视;use'都是我not行'等自我批评句式,减少与对方的互动.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当想到或看到前Male友的婚姻与近况时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将对方的选择当作对自身价值的negate(移情:Ingestion/introjection)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以概括性判断表达'这说明I am not worthy of being loved',忽略复杂背景,语气沉重.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When invited or asked whether she shares inner feelings with relatives and friends
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Worries that expressing herself will intensify pain or be misunderstood, so she chooses to endure in silence
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 礼貌地Displacement话题,强调'我not事',减少情感词,维持冷静语气.
